groups.activity: third main quest, unlocks after Vor's Prize

rows.label: The Teacher
rows.note: reward: Thornbak with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst

conditions: The quest cannot be started while the Backrooms is your base of operations.
Do not sell it. A replacement costs 100,000 Simaris Standing and loses the free slot and Catalyst.

disclosures.title: buying a copy back from Simaris
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells additional copies for 100,000 Standing, with no rank or Mastery gate. The daily cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, about six capped days at MR 0.
